title: Surfaced stale market-data rows in health checks
points: Pipeline Step 19 now promotes stale PSX latest price rows from Step 16 market QC into warning-level data quality flags.
The database health matrix now marks a ticker row yellow when it has an open flag outside the currently displayed statement periods, so stale market-data warnings do not disappear from the dashboard.
Published the refreshed quality-flag table to production D1, including the stale market-data warnings.
